# ICFC Pte Ltd

> Singapore-based audit, consulting and training firm founded in 2014 (UEN 201402439E). Third-party audits are delivered by ICFC auditors on behalf of accredited certification bodies; ICFC does not issue certificates itself. For SOC 1 and SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR and CMMI, ICFC provides readiness, consulting and training only: SOC reports are issued by licensed CPA firms and CMMI ratings by CMMI Certified Lead Appraisers. Impartiality is the primary principle on every service.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://icfc.com.sg/services): 39 services across cybersecurity, IT and data protection, ISO management systems, Singapore standards and sustainability
- [EDGE Grant guide](https://icfc.com.sg/grants/edge): how Singapore's EDGE Grant supports standards projects
- [Training and LMS](https://icfc.com.sg/training): classroom and online courses on icfc.digital
- [About and impartiality](https://icfc.com.sg/about)
- [SS 680 certified consultancy](https://icfc.com.sg/about/ss-680-certified-consultancy): ICFC's consultancy is led by consultants certified to SS 680:2021; the certification is held by the consultants, not by ICFC
- [Contact](https://icfc.com.sg/contact): +65 8601 7001, admin@icfc.com.sg
